hero.kicker: Award-winning B2B marketing for global tech
hero.h1_html: We turn your most ambitious briefs into proven outcomes.
hero.sub: Marketing teams are increasingly pressured to adopt AI, but most don’t know where to start. Intercept is the frontier B2B agency for global tech, helping clients use AI to make the keep-the-lights-on work more efficient and power the innovation that redefines the buyer experience.

problems.lead: Four that global tech keeps bringing us.

items.tabName: Research is stale by the time you act.
items.name: The Intelligence Problem
items.quote: My research is stale by the time we act on it, and we’re always a step behind the market.
tells: Traditional research is too slow and too expensive for the pace we move at.
The findings come back telling us what we already knew.
We can never be sure we’re not hearing from the same panel of people again.
items.signalLbl: of the data marketers use to make business decisions is incomplete, inaccurate, or out of date. (Adverity, State of Marketing Data Quality, 2025)
items.bridge: We triangulate live signals no single source can see on its own, keeping go-to-market current and putting on-demand account research in sellers’ hands.

items.tabName: AI now sits between you and the buyer.
items.name: The Visibility Problem
items.quote: We’ve spent our entire careers understanding human buyers. We have no idea how to influence the AI now deciding what they see.
tells: ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews now sit between you and the buyer.
The content that persuades a human does not win an engine. Winning one takes content built for it on purpose.
Leadership wants the score moved now, but the training behind the answers is already locked.
items.signalLbl: Of B2B software buyers now begin their research in an AI chatbot rather than a search engine. (G2 Buyer Behavior Report, 2025)
items.bridge: Through voice-of-customer research, we learn how buyers actually prompt the AI engines. We then simulate thousands of those prompts across industries, buying journeys, and personas to map where you show up and where you don’t. From there, we build the content and campaigns that make you the answer buyers get.

items.tabName: Content and campaigns can’t keep pace with the market.
items.name: The Velocity Problem
items.quote: By the time our content and campaigns are ready, the moment has passed.
items.attrib: A Global Campaigns Director, enterprise platform
tells: Every persona, account, and buying stage needs its own version, and there are too many to pre-produce.
Too many review layers, and agencies that don’t know the subject matter, so we end up rewriting everything.
The team keeps shrinking while the demand keeps growing, so we have to move faster with less.
items.signalLbl: of marketers say they need more personalized content than they’re able to produce. (Salesforce, State of Marketing, 2026)
items.bridge: We triangulate live signals, then run human-led ideas, hero content, and positioning through an AI-native content and campaign engine. It versions that work for every persona, account, stage, and language, and gets it to your execution teams fast enough to meet the moment.

items.tabName: Content and campaigns get produced, then never reach the right people.
items.name: The Activation Problem
items.quote: We produce more content and campaigns than ever, but most of it never reaches the right people, and our partners rarely pick it up.
items.attrib: A VP of Demand Generation, enterprise platform
tells: We produce more content and campaign kits than anyone can use, and no one knows what to reach for when.
Partners are buried in generic campaigns from every vendor, and adapting ours takes more resources than they have.
We can’t always tell where our audience is paying attention, so we keep defaulting to the same channels.
items.signalLbl: Most B2B technology revenue flows through indirect channels, yet most co-marketing content never gets activated.
items.bridge: We run activation through our 10-point go-to-market flywheel, so every stage fires together, and the right content reaches the right person at the right time. Then we equip your channel partners to extend that reach into markets your own team can’t cover alone.

os.h2: The AI-native layer behind better work.
os.lead: You get the latest AI models and tools, plus our proprietary capabilities, working on your campaigns. We bring the enterprise rigor, so all of it meets the privacy, legal, and governance standards you’re held to. See how it works.

flows.job: Bring every signal together so you’re never a step behind.

stages.name: Aggregate the signals
stages.desc: Pull together real-time market signals, what buyers are downloading and the topics they’re searching, and AI-powered desk research, so you see shifts as they happen.

stages.name: Scan the competition
stages.desc: Run a continuous competitive scan across search, AI engines, paid social, content, and brand, and track how their messaging and positioning shift over time.

stages.name: Map the account
stages.desc: Map each buying committee’s priorities, pain points, and the events their execs attend, then recommend the content to put in front of them.

stages.name: Greater go-to-market precision
stages.desc: You know the pain points, priorities, and buying triggers at the industry, persona, and account level, plus the competitive landscape, so you can design go-to-market campaigns with far greater precision.

flows.job: Show up when buyers ask the AI engines, and build the content that gets you cited.

stages.name: Test the prompts buyers actually use
stages.desc: Learn how real buyers prompt the engines, then run those prompts across ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews to see where you surface and where you’re left out.

stages.name: Map the content gaps
stages.desc: Find where your content is missing, thin, or unreadable to search engines, compared to the questions buyers are actually asking.

stages.name: Build the content that gets cited
stages.desc: We don’t stop at the gaps. We build content that engines can read and cite, structured using our BETA framework (Best-fit, Evidence, Trade-offs, Answerability).

stages.name: You become the answer
stages.desc: When buyers ask the AI engines, you’re in the answer they get, because the content is built to be cited.

flows.job: Produce the right content fast enough to move with the market.

stages.name: Pinpoint what to produce
stages.desc: Read what the market needs right now, from the shifts and gaps Intelligence and Visibility surfaced, and pinpoint the content and campaigns worth making.

stages.name: Audit what you have
stages.desc: Run an agentic audit of your existing content and campaigns to see how well-positioned you are to meet that, and where you fall short.

stages.name: Atomize and hyper-personalize
stages.desc: Atomize what you have into hyper-personalized variants by segment, account, and stage, pre-tested with neuroscience data so the strongest creative goes out.

stages.name: Right content, ready to activate
stages.desc: You have the right content and campaigns to meet each customer segment’s real-time needs, and you’re set up to activate.

flows.job: Get the right content in front of the right people at the right time, across your channels and partners.

stages.name: Decide where to focus
stages.desc: Pinpoint which segments, accounts, and markets need to move, global or regional, and the business impact you’re driving. AI-powered propensity modeling narrows it to the accounts most likely to convert.

stages.name: Pick the right channels and the right content
stages.desc: Whether your execution partners run it or we do, we pick the right channels for each audience and make sure the content is purpose-built for them.

stages.name: Arm the channel and the field
stages.desc: Channel partners get campaign agents that adapt your global campaigns and run them in market fast. AI call-downs generate and qualify regional leads, and sellers rehearse against simulated audiences.

stages.name: Your campaigns run in every market
stages.desc: Everyone executing is aligned and equipped, whether that’s your team, a partner, or us. The right regional accounts are in focus, and your channel partners are executing your campaigns in market.

agents.lead: InterceptOS includes a growing set of AI-powered capabilities that support strategy, content, sales, and channel work. Choose a category to see what each one helps your team do.

items.name: Watchtower
items.desc: Watchtower tracks stance and intent across a windowed sample of 20 million people globally, then surfaces sentiment shifts, trigger events, and buyer signals within hours.
items.sample: For Microsoft, Watchtower ran global ITDM and BDM persona studies across SMC and Enterprise to shape the customer-journey toolkit its partners use.

items.name: Dive
items.role: Deep research on markets, buyers, and competitors.
items.desc: Dive researches vendor websites, public signals, analyst coverage, and competitor positioning shifts, then turns the findings into briefs your team can act on.
items.sample: For AMD’s PRO Component campaign, Dive mapped the system integrator landscape across five regions: APJ, EMEA, India, LATAM, and North America.

items.name: Camille
items.role: Synthetic buyer twins for neuroscience-led message testing.
items.desc: Camille tests messaging, content, and creative against modeled ITDM and BDM buyer reactions before the work reaches a real audience.
items.sample: For Logitech, Camille scored three event-theme directions against a modeled enterprise buying committee on stopping power, buyer relevance, value clarity, and emotional resonance.

items.name: Geo
items.role: GEO performance tracking and opportunity audits.
items.desc: Geo tracks where your brand appears across ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews. It shows where you are cited, where you are missed, and which content gaps to fix before the next leadership readout.
items.sample: For Qualcomm, Geo ran 557 buyer-validated prompts across five AI engines, 2,785 responses, to show how Snapdragon is framed against competing silicon and Apple, and where to close the gaps.

items.name: Cam
items.role: AI video production for stories and live-shoot style clips.
items.desc: Cam creates synthetic-presenter videos in multiple languages, so teams can produce consistent video without coordinating every SME shoot.
items.sample: For SAP, Cam piloted an AI avatar video series through Intercept Labs, producing synthetic-presenter videos that cut production costs 55% and timelines 23%.

items.name: Cortex
items.desc: Cortex tests creative for attention, recall, and emotional response before media spend is committed. It is trained on brainwave and eye-tracking data from 300,000+ users.
items.sample: For Lenovo IDG, Cortex tested webinar creative and picked the direction that drove the strongest engagement.

items.name: Atom
items.desc: Atom turns a hero asset into tailored variants for specific personas, segments, industries, and journey stages. Brand-safety scans help keep each version aligned before it goes live.
items.sample: For HP Workforce Solutions, Atom atomized hero content into tailored variants for each buying-committee persona, fueling a cross-sell campaign that drove 398% deal-size lift and 13.5× pipeline growth.

items.name: Lens
items.role: Modular photoshoots with consistent people and devices.
items.desc: Lens creates photorealistic lifestyle imagery with consistent characters, scenes, and devices, so teams can produce on-brand campaign visuals without booking a full shoot every time.
items.sample: For Microsoft, Lens built an AI photography engine that produced culturally relevant, OEM-flexible imagery for channel partners worldwide.

items.name: Index
items.desc: Index maps your content inventory against buyer-journey stages, identifies the gaps, and shows what needs to be created, updated, or retired.
items.sample: For AMD’s PRO Technologies global relaunch, Index audited the existing content against the buyer journey and mapped the gaps to close before launch.

items.name: Telly
items.desc: Telly runs brand-trained call-down programs that qualify prospects, clean data, and prompt next-best actions such as webinar registration, trial activation, or follow-up.
items.sample: HP used Telly for the Concierge Program Junior BDR, delivering 1,600 live conversations, 320 sales-ready leads, and 3× more cost-effective outreach than human reps.

items.name: Sales Dojo
items.role: Customer scenario simulations for sales reps.
items.desc: Sales Dojo gives reps a brand-trained buyer simulation where they can practice pitches, handle objections, and improve their talk track before a live customer conversation.
items.sample: As part of an exploration, we set up a Copilot+ PC practice environment in Sales Dojo where reps could rehearse pitching to different members of the buying committee.

items.name: Radar
items.role: Live account intelligence on demand for your sellers.
items.desc: Radar identifies the members of each buying committee, reads the market signals and events around them, and recommends the sales plays to run for each account.
items.sample: HP used Radar to give sellers on-demand account intelligence, delivering account briefs within 48 hours.

items.name: Taylor
items.desc: Taylor gives your channel partners an agent trained on your brand guidelines and the campaign bill of materials. Partners upload their own assets, and Taylor shows them how to adapt the campaign to their brand and layer in their own offerings and services. A deterministic QA agent checks every output before it goes out.
items.sample: HP and Intel use Taylor to help their channel partners quickly create high-quality, on-brand marketing rooted in shared HP, Intel, and Windows 11 messaging.

work.h2: Three engagements that delivered verified outcomes.
work.lead: A snapshot of recent work for global tech brands. Open any case for the full brief, the work, and the results.

cases.name: AI-powered ABX for Workforce Solutions
cases.summary: Cross-sell GTM across HP’s Workforce Solutions portfolio, with a buying-committee surround strategy and AI-powered customer journeys tailored per role and stage.
cases.challenge: HP needed to cross-sell across the Workforce Solutions portfolio, a complex mix of AI PCs, meeting room solutions, and services, into established enterprise accounts. The buying committee was scattered across roles, and traditional ABM playbooks were over-relying on uniform creative.
cases.approach: We built a buying-committee surround strategy and purpose-built customer journeys, powered by AI-driven content tailored per persona and journey stage. Atom recomposed the hero asset into thousands of brand-safe variants targeted at each committee member’s role and context.
results: 398% incremental deal-size lift versus control group
13.5× higher pipeline growth versus control group
Pattern is now Intercept’s reference ABX motion for enterprise OEMs
5 x B2B marketing awards including Hermes Creative Awards (2026), MarCom (2025), and CMA Awards (2025).

cases.name: Award-winning ABM for enterprise cloud migration
cases.summary: Precision ABX targeting 250 enterprise accounts. We anchored the cloud-migration story in clear metaphors, paired with GenAI personalization and an intent-led nurture engine.
cases.challenge: Intel needed to drive demand for a complex cloud solution into a tightly-scoped 250 enterprise accounts. The story was hard to explain to the right buyers, and off-the-shelf ABM tools weren’t built for the precision required.
cases.approach: We simplified the cloud-migration story with clear metaphors, built an intent-led nurture engine for DevOps and FinOps audiences, and powered the creative with GenAI personalization. A risk-free 12-month trial accelerated adoption decisions inside the target accounts.
results: 7 x B2B marketing awards, including Echo (2024), CMA (2024), MarCom (2024), ANA B2 (2025), Elevation (2025), Hermes (2025), and dotCoMM.

cases.name: Award-winning AI avatars for multilingual videos at scale
cases.summary: A modular 5-part story framework, AI avatars across 140+ languages, and a shared system anyone at SAP could use. Pilot scaled from a 12-video proof point to 100+ in production, with 55% lower production costs and 23% faster delivery.
cases.challenge: SAP powers over two-thirds of the world’s transactions, demanding constant engagement across markets and languages. Video was the most powerful channel, but without a shared system, content was duplicated, costs ballooned, and brand consistency slipped across regions.
cases.approach: We used AI avatars to speed production across 140+ languages, then built the scalable system around it: a global playbook for narrative and brand standards, streamlined intake forms, a shared tracker for cross-region visibility, and a modular 5-part story framework (Intro, Value, Challenge, Demo, CTA) that turns product demos into narratives. Every video carries transparent AI disclosure, and the avatars mirror global audiences for relatability.
results: Scaled from a 12-video pilot to 100+ videos in active production
AI avatar videos delivered across 140+ languages
2× Gold at the Hermes Creative Awards 2025 in the AI-Assisted Video Production and the Emerging Tech Innovation categories

items.a: Intercept is an award-winning B2B marketing agency built for the global technology sector. Established in 2006, we help the world’s largest tech brands turn ambitious briefs into proven outcomes. The majority of our work supports US and international marketing teams across North America, Europe, and Asia. We run an AI-native delivery model that makes the keep-the-lights-on work more efficient, freeing room for the frontier work that redefines the buyer experience.

InterceptOS is our AI-native operating system for B2B marketing. It standardizes how campaigns are strategized, produced, activated, and measured across teams and partners, built on Intercept’s award-winning frameworks and run as a managed service that de-risks adoption.

Intercept Labs is our co-investment model for first-of-its-kind work. When a brief has no precedent, we fund up to half the cost and share the risk to prove it, then fold the breakthrough back into the operating system. Recent Labs work includes an AI avatar video pilot with SAP. Read more.
items.a_html: Intercept Labs is our co-investment model for first-of-its-kind work. When a brief has no precedent, we fund up to half the cost and share the risk to prove it, then fold the breakthrough back into the operating system. Recent Labs work includes an AI avatar video pilot with SAP. Read more.

items.a: We’ve spent nearly two decades inside global tech, so we speak your buyers’ language with no learning curve. That depth has earned more than 130 awards since 2019. We pair it with proprietary buyer intelligence that tracks what the market is really saying when you’re not in the room, and an in-house technology practice that builds our own AI rather than waiting on outside vendors. And because we work with the world’s largest enterprises, privacy, legal, and procurement review is built into how we operate, so innovation never slows the work.

items.q: What kinds of challenges do you help solve?
items.a: Most agencies don’t really understand the subject matter, so we bring deep expertise in B2B global tech and speak the language of product, channel, and engineering teams. They also miss how the value chain fits together, from ISVs to OEMs to distributors to channel partners, where we know the role each one plays. And right now, many clients are being told to sprint toward AI agents without a clear sense of what that even means. We give them a path through InterceptOS and our innovation sprints, where we identify the right AI use cases, build a proof of concept, and take what works to production.

items.q: How do you handle security, privacy, and compliance?
items.a: We work with the world’s largest enterprises, so enterprise rigor is built into how we operate. Privacy, legal, and procurement reviews happen from day one, and we sit in those reviews with you. Because we run our AI as a managed service, you don’t have to stand up a new approval workflow every time the technology evolves. We protect the security and compliance posture and carry the model risk, so the innovation work stays above board.
We work with global technology brands including Microsoft, SAP, HP, Lenovo, Cisco, AMD, Qualcomm, Logitech, BMC, Nokia, and TELUS.

items.q: What industries do you work in?
items.a: We support the entire end-to-end technology value chain, from silicon and ISVs to OEMs, hyperscalers, networking infrastructure, distributors, and the channel and partner programs that bring it all to market.
Book a call to talk through your brief or your challenge, and we’ll figure out the path forward together.

items.q: Can you work alongside our other agencies?
items.a: Yes. We work with the largest enterprises in the world, where collaboration is the norm, so we partner easily with other agencies and specialists. We believe more good heads on a problem make the work better.

We sit down with you at the start to define the KPIs and metrics that matter, then measure against them throughout. That runs from pre-launch testing of how the work will land to in-market tracking of campaign performance, brand health, and the lift the work drives over time.
